warmup.note: Longest selected feature needs 60 returns / 61 closes; the liquidity lookback (63) is the binding requirement and warmup rows lacking any of the twelve features are excluded consistently.

question: Given only these completed daily indicators, will buying at the next exchange session's 10:00 New York hourly open and selling at the following exchange session's 10:00 hourly open yield a strictly positive return after 0.035 percent cost on each side?

target.exit: following exchange session 10:00 America/New_York hourly open
